A number of '''Ishi Tib ornaments''' adorned the interior of Jabba's sail barge, the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] and his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
These statuettes of [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] heads were first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in which they appeared adorning the interior of Jabba the Hutt's personal sail barge the ''Khetanna'' as well as his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] walls.
